InfoPoints.Title: SECTION 1.1
InfoPoints.Body:
Point with the LASER on your controller and pull the TRIGGER to INTERACT with BUTTONS and OBJECTS in the environment.

Pull the TRIGGER on the second INFORMATION button below this panel.

InfoPoints.Title: SECTION 1.2
InfoPoints.Body:
To your right is a QUICK TELEPORT button.

Pointing the LASER at this button will show you the space you will travel to and the direction you will face when you get there.

To continue pull the TRIGGER and INTERACT with the QUICK TELEPORT button.
